summary: Karya Binayak Temple is a Ganesh shrine near Bungamati in Lalitpur. Combine a temple visit with a walk through Bungamati and neighbouring Khokana for a day of Newar heritage, traditional craftsmanship and local food. Visit Rato Machhindranath Temple, explore village lanes and ask about seeing Khokana’s traditional mustard-oil production.

fields.destination_description:
Begin with a visit to Karya Binayak Temple, then take time to explore the surrounding settlements. In Bungamati, visit Rato Machhindranath Temple and its square, notice the carved wooden windows and look for opportunities to see local woodcarvers at work. The village’s temples, courtyards and craft traditions give the outing a rich cultural setting.

Continue to Khokana to explore its lanes and public squares. Traditional mustard-oil production is an important part of the village’s living heritage. Ask locally which traditional mill is operating and whether visitors may watch; a working demonstration depends on the production schedule. Ask permission before photographing workers or entering a workshop.

If you have more time, extend the outing to Shikali Temple outside Khokana. Choose a few stops and leave time for a meal, photographs and conversations along the way.
fields.destination_description_ne:
कार्यविनायक मन्दिर दर्शनबाट यात्रा सुरु गरेर वरपरका बस्ती घुम्न समय छुट्याउनुहोस्। बुङ्गमतीको रातो मच्छिन्द्रनाथ मन्दिर र चोक घुम्नुहोस्, काठमा कुँदिएका झ्याल नियाल्नुहोस् र स्थानीय काष्ठकलाकारको काम हेर्न मिल्छ कि भनेर बुझ्नुहोस्। यहाँका मन्दिर, चोक र परम्परागत सीपले घुमघामलाई सांस्कृतिक अनुभव बनाउँछन्।

त्यसपछि खोकनाका गल्ली र सार्वजनिक चोक घुम्नुहोस्। परम्परागत तोरीको तेल उत्पादन यस बस्तीको जीवित सम्पदाको महत्त्वपूर्ण अंश हो। कुन परम्परागत कोल चलिरहेको छ र आगन्तुकले हेर्न मिल्छ कि भनेर स्थानीयसँग बुझ्नुहोस्; उत्पादन हेर्न पाइने कुरा कामको तालिकामा निर्भर हुन्छ। कामदारको फोटो खिच्न वा कार्यशालामा पस्नुअघि अनुमति लिनुहोस्।

समय भए खोकनाबाहिरको सिकाली मन्दिरसम्म घुमघाम बढाउनुहोस्। केही ठाउँ छानेर खाना, फोटो र कुराकानीका लागि पनि समय राख्नुहोस्।

stops.stop_description: Include the temple and its square in your Bungamati walk. The shrine is central to the settlement’s religious and cultural life.

stops.stop_description: Ask which traditional kol is working and whether you may watch the process. Production is scheduled work, so a demonstration is not guaranteed. If buying oil, ask the producer about the product and price.

fields.visit_notes:
For groups

Combine the two village walks, temple stops and a local meal. Arrange an oil-mill visit in advance where possible, and agree a meeting point before splitting up.

For couples

Choose an unhurried Bungamati–Khokana walk with photographs and a meal. Add Shikali if you have time; keep Taudaha as a separate transport extension.

For families

Keep the route shorter for young children or older relatives. Use transport between settlements as needed and ask about steps, toilets and drop-off points locally.

Before you go

Confirm the oil mill’s operating schedule, return transport and current access. Ask permission before filming people or work areas. Keep temple visits separate from picnic plans and ask where eating is permitted.

Karya Binayak Temple is a Ganesh shrine near Bungamati in Lalitpur. Combine a temple visit with a walk through Bungamati and neighbouring Khokana for a day of Newar heritage, traditional craftsmanship and local food. Visit Rato Machhindranath Temple, explore village lanes and ask about seeing Khokana’s traditional mustard-oil production.

Suggested day-trip route

Karya Binayak → Bungamati and Rato Machhindranath Temple → lunch → Khokana and a traditional oil mill, when operating → optional Shikali Temple.

Begin with a visit to Karya Binayak Temple, then take time to explore the surrounding settlements. In Bungamati, visit Rato Machhindranath Temple and its square, notice the carved wooden windows and look for opportunities to see local woodcarvers at work. The village’s temples, courtyards and craft traditions give the outing a rich cultural setting.

Continue to Khokana to explore its lanes and public squares. Traditional mustard-oil production is an important part of the village’s living heritage. Ask locally which traditional mill is operating and whether visitors may watch; a working demonstration depends on the production schedule. Ask permission before photographing workers or entering a workshop.

If you have more time, extend the outing to Shikali Temple outside Khokana. Choose a few stops and leave time for a meal, photographs and conversations along the way.

Plan the outing

For groups

Combine the two village walks, temple stops and a local meal. Arrange an oil-mill visit in advance where possible, and agree a meeting point before splitting up.

For couples

Choose an unhurried Bungamati–Khokana walk with photographs and a meal. Add Shikali if you have time; keep Taudaha as a separate transport extension.

For families

Keep the route shorter for young children or older relatives. Use transport between settlements as needed and ask about steps, toilets and drop-off points locally.

Before you go

Confirm the oil mill’s operating schedule, return transport and current access. Ask permission before filming people or work areas. Keep temple visits separate from picnic plans and ask where eating is permitted.

Destination guide

Read the Karya Binayak destination guide for the gallery, transport information and nearby stops.
